comparison.objective: Steer an always-on laser through two mirrors onto a detector while blocking the beam during adjustment; candidate registers proximity switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Free-body mirror pose adjustment, beam blocking, and optical feedback versus mounted linear sliding plus screw loosening and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Beam must reflect from both mirrors to within 10 mm of detector center without stray beam or moving a lit mirror; candidate requires two mechanically retained sensor states.
comparison.reason: Both use state feedback for alignment, but the record tests safe optical pose planning without fastening or pose retention under tightening. Candidate indicator hysteresis and drift limits are missing.
